claims.claim: A single AAV injection produced significant health gains that lasted at least two months in mice with generalised lipodystrophy, including reduced fatty liver and lower diabetes markers.
claims.episode_span: Researchers at the Rowett Institute tested an adeno-associated virus carrying leptin instructions in mice with generalised lipodystrophy. A single injection produced significant health gains that lasted at least two months, including reduced fatty liver, lower diabetes markers, and decreased hunger.
claims.source_title: Gene therapy advance for life-limiting body fat condition
claims.supporting_quote: In a paper published in the journal Gene Therapy, they show that a single injection of the AAV carrying the instructions to make leptin led to significant improvements in the health of mice with lipodystrophy for a period of at least two months.

claims.claim: Disrupting a single gene in petunias changed the flowers' mix of scent compounds, increasing some associated with vanilla and cloves.
claims.episode_span: Disrupting one gene altered both pigment pathways and the blend of volatile scent compounds. Some vanilla- and clove-associated volatiles increased, showing the same cellular machinery influences both traits.
claims.source_title: A hidden link between a flower's color and its scent revealed
claims.supporting_quote: By disrupting a single gene in petunias, they changed the flowers' mix of scent compounds, increasing some associated with vanilla and cloves.

claims.claim: A randomized trial of 100 patients undergoing coronary angiography found the music group had a 13 mm lower post-procedure systolic blood pressure.
claims.episode_span: A randomized trial assigned 100 patients undergoing coronary angiography with or without PCI to music before and during the procedure. The music group showed a 13 mm lower post-procedure systolic blood pressure and reduced heart rate.
claims.source_title: Music therapy lowers blood pressure in angiography trial
claims.supporting_quote: A small randomized trial of 100 patients undergoing coronary angiography (+/- PCI) found the group assigned to music before and during the procedure had a significantly lower post-procedure systolic blood pressure (13 mm), the primary endpoint, and reduced heart rate

claims.supporting_quote: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) make up around 95% of Scotland's food and drink sector.

claims.claim: The study conducted workshops, interviews and six in-depth case studies with Scottish food producers and wholesalers.

claims.supporting_quote: From 2025 to 2026, researchers held workshops and interviews with Scottish food producers and wholesalers. They also carried out six in-depth case studies, ranging from family-run producers to island wholesalers.

claims.claim: A new experimental model shows that specific immune-system gene variants determine why only a small fraction of the 90 percent of people infected with Epstein-Barr virus develop multiple sclerosis.
claims.episode_span: A new experimental model shows that specific immune-system gene variants determine why only a small fraction of the 90 percent of people infected with Epstein-Barr virus develop multiple sclerosis.
claims.source_title: Epstein-Barr virus and MS: new model points to genetic immune susceptibility
claims.supporting_quote: Epstein-Barr virus infects 90% of the world's population, so what accounts for the very small fraction of individuals who develop multiple sclerosis? A new experimental model study pointing to immune system genetic susceptibility @PNASNews
